name: player_ai_enter_mode2_steering_pursuit
description: AINet::AiEnterMode2SteeringPursuit enters AI steering pursuit, records state timing, snapshots the restore target, and seeds dynamic-offset pursuit direction when requested.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player AI source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x401c60 shows the finalized-state gate, previous top-level state save, steering-state transition, stateStart/stateEnd time writes from g_Player_TotalTimeSecScaled and attack dwell, restore-target copy from the selected path neighbor, and dynamic-offset direction normalization only for steering substate 2.
The native smoke checks the finalized gate, normal steering transition/timing/restore-target copy, dynamic-offset XZ normalization, and non-dynamic substate no-op for aiDynamicOffsetDir.
